summary: Indonesian often permits nominal/adjectival predication without an overt copula; adalah/ialah are restricted equative/classificatory copulas, while ada handles existence/presence.

semantic_map.SEM.IDENTITY_EQUIVALENCE: zero copula or adalah/ialah in equative/formal contexts
semantic_map.SEM.CLASSIFICATION_ROLE: zero copula or adalah/ialah + class/role NP
semantic_map.SEM.CHARACTERISTIC_PROPERTY: adjective/property predicate directly, normally without obligatory copula
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: state/adjective predicate directly; optional particles/verbs add aspect/change
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: result-state adjective or sudah + predicate / menjadi for change
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: di + location with zero copula; berada for explicit/formal location
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: event-specific berlangsung/diadakan according to event type
semantic_map.SEM.TIME_DATE_PREDICATION: zero/adalah in nominal time/date identification by style
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: punya/memiliki ordinary; ada can express availability but is not a universal possessive copula
